connection_authentication.note: Catalog/file integrity rests on the XXTEA length word and AES PKCS#7 padding, not on an HMAC. No HMAC library call was traced to a connection-authentication purpose. VPN transport and connection authentication were not researched for this build.
connection_authentication.rule: The mere presence of an HMAC library or a Mac.init call confirms nothing. No key values and no hook inputs/outputs are stored in this dossier.
